name: @kaaloo/memfs-sync
description: Two-way sync between a Letta Code MemFS checkout and a shared GitHub memory repository: fast-forward at turn start, then rebase, re-sign, regenerate indexes and push local memory commits, never force-pushing.
author: Luis Arias

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:bundle: bun build mods/index.ts --target node --outfile /tmp/memfs-sync-bundle-drift-check.mjs && cmp -s /tmp/memfs-sync-bundle-drift-check.mjs mods/index.bundled.mjs && echo 'bundle matches source' || (echo 'BUNDLE DRIFT: mods/index.bundled.mjs does not match source — run npm run build and commit the bundle' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: npm run verify:bundle && npm run typecheck && npm run test
